docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
Flint is currently available only for Linux.

Prerequisits: - GCC/Clang compiler chain - GIT

Run the following command in terminal:

curl -fsSL -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3.raw" https://api.github.com/repos/mainak55512/flint/contents/install.sh | bash

flint is invoked as:

flint <command> [args]

Running flint with no command prints a short usage summary and exits with status 1.

docs.title: init
docs.text:
Initialize a new flint project in the current directory.

flint init

docs.title: add <url>@<version>
docs.text:
Add a remote library dependency by URL.

flint add <url>@<version>
Note: version is the tag name of the remote repository. To install the latest version of the library use @unknown. The remote repository must contain composition.json.

e.g. flint add https://github.com/mainak55512/arena@v0.1.1 or, flint add https://github.com/mainak55512/arena@unknown

Arguments

Argument Description url The URL of the library to add as a dependency

docs.title: remove <chert name>
docs.text:
Remove a dependency from the project

flint remove <chert name>
e.g. flint remove raylib

Arguments

Argument Description cher name The name of the library be removed

docs.title: add-lib [args...]
docs.text:
Add one or more local libraries to the project.

flint add-lib [args...]

Arguments

Argument Description args... One or more local library paths/names to register

docs.title: add-flag [args...]
docs.text:
Add one or more compiler/build flags to the project configuration.

flint add-flag [args...]

Arguments

Argument Description args... One or more flags to add to the build configuration

docs.title: build
docs.text:
Build the project.

flint build

docs.title: run
docs.text:
Build (if needed) and run the project.

flint run

docs.title: gen
docs.text:
Generate a compile_commands.json file for the project, for use with editor/IDE tooling and language servers.

flint gen

docs.title: sync
docs.text:
Sync project dependencies (e.g. fetch/update declared libraries).

flint sync

Note: Declare the chert composition in the dependencies section of your composition.json. Example chert composition:

"arena": {
    "version": "v0.1.1",
    "include_paths": [
        "include"
    ],
    "src": [
        "lib"
    ],
    "remote": "https://github.com/mainak55512/arena"
}

docs.title: cache
docs.text:
Clears the cache of the project

flint cache

docs.title: Exit Codes
docs.text: Code Meaning 0 Command completed successfully 1 No command provided, or an unknown command was given

docs.title: Quick Reference
docs.text: Command Description init Initialize a new project add <url> Add a remote library dependency remove <chert name> Remove a dependency add-lib [args...] Add local library dependencies add-flag [args...] Add build flags build Build the project run Build and run the project gen Generate compile_commands.json sync Sync dependencies cache Clear build cache

docs.title: Flint Cherts
docs.text: Paste the "composition" for the dependency in the sync section of your composition.json file and run flint sync.

docs.title: Arena (lang: C)
docs.text:
An arena allocator written purely in C.

Install with flint:

flint add https://github.com/mainak55512/arena@v0.1.1

Or, 

flint add cherts:arena

Composition:

"arena": {
    "version": "v0.1.1",
    "remote": "https://github.com/mainak55512/arena"
}

docs.title: CString (lang: C)
docs.text:
A String library with basic string manipulation capabilities. Uses arena allocator as dependency.

Install with flint:

flint add https://github.com/mainak55512/CString@v0.1.1

Or,

flint add cherts:CString

Composition:

"CString": {
    "version": "v0.1.1",
    "remote": "https://github.com/mainak55512/CString"
}

"yyjson": {

docs.title: Crow (lang: C++)
docs.text:
A http server library for C++ projects.

Install with flint:

flint add cherts:crow

Composition:

"Crow": {
    "version": "unknown",
    "flags": [
        "-std=c++17", "-O3", "-DASIO_NO_DEPRECATED",
        "-DCROW_ENABLE_SSL", "-DCROW_ENABLE_COMPRESSION"
    ],
    "lib_links": [
        "-lpthread", "-lssl", "-lcrypto", "-lz"
    ],
    "exclude_dirs": ["cmake", "docs", "examples", "scripts", "tests"],
    "remote": "https://github.com/CrowCpp/Crow"
}

docs.title: Raylib (lang: C)
docs.text:
A graphics simulation library.

NOTE: the flags may change on the basis of environment. Below composition is for x11 systems.

Install with flint:

flint add cherts:raylib

Composition:

"raylib": {
    "version": "unknown",
    "flags": [
        "-std=c99", "-D_GNU_SOURCE", "-DGL_SILENCE_DEPRECATION=199309L",
        "-DPLATFORM_DESKTOP_GLFW", "-DGRAPHICS_API_OPENGL_33",
        "-DSUPPORT_MODULE_RSHAPES=1", "-DSUPPORT_MODULE_RTEXTURES=1",
        "-DSUPPORT_MODULE_RTEXT=1", "-DSUPPORT_MODULE_RMODELS=1",
        "-DSUPPORT_MODULE_RAUDIO=1", "-D_GLFW_X11"
    ],
    "lib_links": [
        "-lGL", "-lX11", "-lXrandr", "-lXinerama", "-lXi",
        "-lXcursor", "-lm", "-lpthread", "-ldl", "-lrt"
    ],

    "excludes": [
        "src/rcore_desktop.c", "src/rcore_desktop_glfw.c",
        "src/rcore_desktop_sdl.c", "src/rcore_web.c",
        "src/rcore_android.c", "src/rcore_drm.c", "src/raylib.rc"
    ],
    "exclude_dirs": [
        "examples", "projects", "tools",
        "src/external", "src/platforms"
    ],
    "exclude_exception": ["src/external/glfw/include"],
    "remote": "https://github.com/raysan5/raylib.git"
}

docs.title: lua (lang: C)
docs.text:
An embeddable scripting language. This is the library version of the scripting language.

NOTE: the flags may change on the basis of environment.

Install with flint:

flint add cherts:lua

Composition:

"lua": {
  "version": "v5.5.1",
  "remote": "https://github.com/lua/lua",
  "flags": [
    "-std=c99", "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Wfatal-errors", "-Wshadow",
    "-Wundef", "-Wwrite-strings", "-Wredundant-decls", "-Wdisabled-optimization",
    "-Wdouble-promotion", "-Wmissing-declarations", "-Wconversion", "-Wlogical-op",
    "-Wno-aggressive-loop-optimizations", "-Wdeclaration-after-statement",
    "-Wmissing-prototypes", "-Wnested-externs", "-Wstrict-prototypes",
    "-Wc++-compat", "-Wold-style-definition", "-DLUA_USE_LINUX",
    "-fno-stack-protector", "-fno-common", "-Wl,-E"
  ],
  "lib_links": [
    "-ldl", "-lm"
  ],
  "excludes": [
    "lua.c", "onelua.c"
  ],
  "exclude_dirs": ["testes"]
}

docs.title: libsodium (lang: C)
docs.text:
A crypto library in C

Install with flint:

flint add cherts:libsodium

Composition:

"libsodium": {
    "version": "unknown",
    "tmpl": {
        "SODIUM_LIBRARY_VERSION_MAJOR": "30",
        "SODIUM_LIBRARY_VERSION_MINOR":"0",
        "DLL_VERSION": "30",
        "SODIUM_LIBRARY_VERSION": "30:0:0"

    "flags": ["-w"],
    "lib_links": ["-lpthread"],
    "exclude_dirs": ["build", "builds", "test"],
    "remote": "https://github.com/jedisct1/libsodium.git"
}

docs.title: Mongoose (lang: C)
docs.text:
A http library for C.

Install with flint:

flint add cherts:mongoose

Composition:

"mongoose": {
    "version": "7.23",
    "remote": "https://github.com/cesanta/mongoose.git",
    "hash": "02bdbb9ed6f0a8f7c42228c6e7cb35d748b60551",
    "lib_links": [
        "windows:-lws2_32",
        "windows:-ladvapi32",
        "windows:-lcrypt32"
    ],
    "flags": [
        "-O3",
        "-Wall",
        "-DMG_TLS=MG_TLS_BUILTIN",
        "-DMG_ENABLE_LOG=0"
    ],
    "exclude_dirs": [
        "resources", "src", "test", "tutorials"
    ]
}

docs.title: libyaml(lang: C)
docs.text:
YAML library written in C

Install with flint:

flint add cherts:libyaml

Composition:

"libyaml": {
    "version": "0.2.5",
    "flags": [
        "-D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L",
        "-DYAML_VERSION_MAJOR=0",
        "-DYAML_VERSION_MINOR=2",
        "-DYAML_VERSION_PATCH=5",
        "'-DYAML_VERSION_STRING=\\\"0.2.5\\\"'",
        "-DYAML_DECLARE_STATIC"
    ],
    "lib_links": [],
    "excludes": [],
    "exclude_dirs": [
        "cmake",
        "doc",
        "examples",
        "tests",
        "win32"
    ],
    "exclude_exception": [],
    "remote": "https://github.com/yaml/libyaml.git"
}

docs.title: libcyaml(lang: C)
docs.text:
Schema based YAML library written in C

Note: libcyaml library depends on libyaml library. If libyaml is already installed in your OS, add -lyaml in lib_links, else add it as a flint dependency with following:

flint add cherts:libyaml

Install with flint:

flint add cherts:libcyaml

Composition:

"libcyaml": {
    "version": "unknown",
    "flags": [
        "-std=c11",
        "-O2",
        "-DNDEBUG",
        "-DVERSION_MAJOR=2",
        "-DVERSION_MINOR=0",
        "-DVERSION_PATCH=0",
        "-DVERSION_DEVEL=1"
    ],
    "lib_links": [],
    "excludes": [],
    "exclude_dirs": [
        "build",
        "docs",
        "examples",
        "test"
    ],
    "exclude_exception": ["include"],
    "remote": "https://github.com/tlsa/libcyaml.git"
}

docs.title: stb(lang: C)
docs.text:
Single-file public domain (or MIT licensed) libraries for C/C++ Included libraries: stb_image.h, stb_image_write.h, stb_image_resize2.h, stb_truetype.h, stb_rect_pack.h, stb_perlin.h, stb_voxel_render.h, stb_dxt.h, stb_easy_font.h, stb_tilemap_editor.h, stb_herringbone_wang_tile.h, stb_vorbis.c, stb_hexwave.h, stb_ds.h, stb_sprintf.h, stb_textedit.h, stb_c_lexer.h, stb_divide.h, stb_include.h, stb_leakcheck.h, stb_connected_components.h

Install with flint:

flint add cherts:stb

Composition:

"stb": {
    "version": "unknown",
    "remote": "https://github.com/nothings/stb.git",
    "lib_links": ["-lm"],
    "exclude_dirs": [
        "tests",
        "deprecated",
        "tools"
    ]
}
